brief:
Families displaced in Gaza are repurposing damaged cooking pots into barriers to contain seawater flooding their tent encampments on the beach as winter conditions worsen, Al Jazeera English reported. The makeshift solution reflects efforts by residents to adapt to harsh living conditions in temporary shelters lacking basic infrastructure and protection from the elements.

Winter weather has brought seawater into beachfront tent camps where families lack formal defenses against flooding. Residents are improvising barriers from damaged pots as humanitarian assistance struggles to reach those sheltering in the encampments.
dek: An innovative idea to turn damaged cooking pots into seawater barriers is providing families in Gaza with some relief.
title: Gaza families devise seawater barriers from damaged pots as winter camps flood
